hints: Look carefully at where each letter is. W and X are in the tissue fluid, while Z is blood at the arteriole end and Y is blood at the venule end. For fluid to move, think which side must have the higher pressure at each end.

Remember blood hydrostatic pressure is high at the arteriole end to push fluid out, but low at the venule end to let fluid back in, while tissue fluid pressure stays fairly constant along the capillary.
walkthrough:
**Label what each point means**

Think of this like two compartments side by side. W is tissue fluid near the arteriole, Z is blood near the arteriole. X is tissue fluid near the venule, Y is blood near the venule.

Fluid always moves from higher pressure to lower pressure across the wall.

**Work out the arteriole end for outward flow**

At the arteriole end, tissue fluid must be formed, so fluid leaves the blood. That means blood pressure at Z must be greater than tissue pressure at W.

$$Pressure\ at\ Z > Pressure\ at\ W$$

**Work out the venule end for inward flow**

At the venule end, most tissue fluid returns to the blood, so fluid enters the blood. That means tissue pressure at X must be greater than blood pressure at Y.

$$Pressure\ at\ X > Pressure\ at\ Y$$

**Add the drop in blood pressure**

Blood loses pressure as it flows along the capillary due to friction, so Z must be much higher than Y. Tissue fluid pressure changes very little, so W and X should be equal and in between.

Only option B gives $Z (36) > W (26)$ for outward flow, $X (26) > Y (18)$ for inward flow, and $Z > Y$ along the capillary.

options.A: Gives Y = 36 higher than X = 26 at the venule end, so fluid would be pushed out instead of being reabsorbed. That is the opposite of what is needed.
options.B: Gives Z (36) > W (26) so fluid is forced out at the arteriole end, and X (26) > Y (18) so fluid is drawn back in at the venule end. Blood pressure also falls from 36 to 18 as expected.
options.C: Gives Z = 18 lower than W = 26 at the arteriole end, so fluid could not leave the blood to form tissue fluid there.
options.D: Gives W = 36 higher than Z = 26 at the arteriole end, so net movement would be into the blood, not out to form tissue fluid.
